RFDose

RFDose.Rmd
library(RFDose)

Overview

RFDose is an R package designed to estimate personal radio-frequency electromagnetic field (RF-EMF) doses. It takes into account different device types and tissues, as well as exposure from far-field sources.

Background

The calculations in this package are based on an RF-EMF dose model developed by Jalilian et al (publication in writing stage as of November 2026). On this page, you can find a summary of the background of this model.

Expected Input Data

The expected input data will be described here once finalized.

Example Usage 

# Load example data from three hypothetical study participants
data(example_data)
# View example data
head(example_data)
#>   sample_id use_5g travel_time country urbanicity headp_ear_num mpc_duration
#> 1     TEST1   TRUE        1800   Other   suburban             2          425
#> 2     TEST2   TRUE        1800      CH      rural             2          120
#> 3     TEST3  FALSE        1800      ES      urban             1          903
#>   mpc_ear_prop mpc_headp_prop mpd_wifi_prop_home mpd_wifi_prop_travel
#> 1         0.66           0.17                0.5                  0.5
#> 2         0.80           0.00                0.5                  0.5
#> 3         0.90           0.10                0.5                  0.5
#>   mpd_wifi_prop_work mpd_dur_low mpd_dur_lowtomed mpd_dur_medtohigh
#> 1                0.5        4860              540              4860
#> 2                0.5           0                0                 0
#> 3                0.5           0                0                 0
#>   mpd_dur_high dect_duration dect_ear_prop lptp_dur_low lptp_dur_lowtomed
#> 1          540           204           0.9         1967               219
#> 2            0           580           0.8            0                 0
#> 3            0            90           0.5            0                 0
#>   lptp_dur_medtohigh lptp_dur_high tblt_dur_low tblt_dur_lowtomed
#> 1               1967           219          728                81
#> 2                  0             0            0                 0
#> 3                  0             0            0                 0
#>   tblt_dur_medtohigh tblt_dur_high hotspot_duration smartwatch_duration
#> 1                728            81                0                   0
#> 2                  0             0                0               86400
#> 3                  0             0              600                   0
#>   vr_duration headphone_duration gaming_duration
#> 1           0                  0             600
#> 2        1200                  0               0
#> 3           0               8280            1200
# Calculate example doses
calculate_emf_doses(example_data, tissue = "brain") # brain dose

Development Status

The RFDose package is still undergoing development. The calculations of the dose may change in future versions.
